Experience.WelcomeBody: Set up your workspace in a few steps. You can change every preference later.
Experience.UpgradeBody: Choose Classic or Modern Dashboard and review update preferences. Your queue, history and saved files stay with you.
Experience.Introduction: Download videos, follow live streams and organize playlists in one workspace. Start with the preferences that matter to you.
Experience.Privacy: This setup does not import browser cookies or enable Web Remote. Those integrations remain under your control in Settings.
Experience.ChangeLater: Both interfaces share your data and download engine. Switch at any time in Settings → Personalization.
Experience.RealPreview: Actual application views with sample data. Your content appears after setup.
Experience.DiskHint: Choose writable folders with enough free space for both temporary and final files. Paths are checked before you continue. No files are moved by this wizard.
Experience.FormatHint: The available quality and format depend on the source. These are defaults; individual downloads can use different options.
Experience.ModeAutoDownload: Download; let me choose when to install
Experience.ModeInstallOnExit: Download and install on full exit (recommended)
Experience.LegacyUpdates: Your older settings did not record explicit consent to automatic installation. Choose the policy here. Skipping preserves your existing policy.
Experience.UpdateSafety: Only stable releases from the official repository are eligible. Downloads are verified; installation waits for a full exit. Hiding in the tray does not install an update.
Experience.SummaryHint: Review your choices. Saving applies only these preferences; your existing media and records remain unchanged.
Experience.InvalidFolder: Choose an absolute, writable folder path. The selected path must not be a file.
Experience.InvalidFilename: Enter a nonempty filename template without line breaks.
Experience.SaveError: The changes could not be saved. Your existing files were preserved. Check the paths or application logs and try again.
Experience.UnsupportedState: This setup state was created by a newer application. Use that version to continue.
Experience.Candidate: Preview build — these changes are in the 1.3.0 candidate. This is not a published stable release.
Experience.Release: Discover the changes in your installed version.
Experience.NewsDashboardBody: Modern Dashboard brings downloads, LIVE, history, Batch Import and settings together with details panels and consistent actions. Classic remains available.
Experience.NewsCollectionsBody: Collapsible playlist groups, paged history and bounded thumbnail loading keep large collections manageable. Your existing task IDs and records are preserved.
Experience.NewsSetupBody: The resumable setup wizard, one-time interface choice and explicit update policy help you get started. You can revisit setup and these notes at any time.
Experience.LinkError: Could not open the browser. The release notes are available in the official repository.
Updates.PolicyHelp: Automatic updates are recommended: download and verify stable releases, then install only after the application fully exits. Minimizing to the tray does not install an update.

Other.TipText: Drop a TXT, CSV or JSON file into the application, or paste a list of links in Batch Import. Review and analyze the list before adding it to the queue.

Experience.ModernDescription: Compact lists, details panels and playlist groups.
Experience.NewsIntroduction: A refreshed workspace, organized collections and an easier way to get started.

Organizer.ConfirmMove: Move {0} selected recordings ({1} files, {2}) to the reviewed destination folders? Verified sidecars move with each recording. Shared central metadata is copied and retained. Existing files will not be overwritten. This operation is journaled and can be undone if the files remain unchanged.
Organizer.ConfirmRecovery: Resume this interrupted operation from its journal? Every existing source and destination will be checked before continuing. Changed or conflicting files stop recovery without overwriting them.
Organizer.ConfirmUndo: Return the verified files to their original locations and restore History and queue paths? Undo stops if a file changed or an original path is occupied. Shared central metadata remains intact.
Organizer.Reason.JsonOptional: Identity verified; JSON requirement was explicitly disabled
Organizer.Reason.Missing: No file with a verified source identity was found
Organizer.Reason.Ambiguous: Several files have this identity; choose explicitly
Organizer.Reason.Invalid: This entry does not contain a supported URL
Organizer.Reason.Collision: The destination already exists; nothing will be overwritten
Organizer.Reason.Already: Files are already in the selected destination
Organizer.Reason.MultipleLists: This recording belongs to several lists; choose one destination explicitly
Organizer.Reason.SharedBasename: Several media formats share the same sidecars; association needs manual attention
Organizer.Reason.Variant: The requested quality or time range cannot be verified for these files
Organizer.Reason.Duplicate: The same URL and variant already appear in this list
Organizer.Error.Access: The operation could not complete. Check file access and available disk space. Any interrupted move remains in the recovery journal.
Organizer.Error.Active: Active, partial and LIVE recordings cannot be moved by this organizer
Organizer.Error.JsonIdentity: JSON is unreadable or does not match the recording identity
Organizer.Error.JsonMissing: Verified JSON metadata is missing. Restore it or explicitly disable the JSON requirement before analyzing again.
Organizer.Error.Limit: This operation exceeds the safety limit: 100 lists, 10,000 entries or 100,000 scanned files. Split it into smaller operations.
Organizer.Error.List: Choose a valid TXT, CSV or JSON URL list
Organizer.Error.OutsideRoot: The path is outside the reviewed folders or belongs to application data or temporary work files
Organizer.Error.Selection: Select verified entries from the current dry run
Organizer.Error.Cancelled: Cancelled. Completed steps remain journaled; use recovery for any interrupted move.
Organizer.Error.Changed: A file changed or is missing. Recovery or undo stopped without overwriting another file.
Organizer.Error.Journal: The operation journal cannot be read safely. Preserve it and inspect the problem before continuing.
Organizer.Error.RecoveryRequired: An earlier operation needs recovery. Resolve it before starting another move.
Organizer.Error.Path: Use a valid absolute local folder path without device names, traversal or network shares
Organizer.Error.Reparse: System paths, symbolic links and junctions are excluded
Organizer.Error.Root: Choose a specific folder, not the root of a drive
RemoteWeb.invalid: Check URL, quality, container and time range.
RemoteWeb.failed: The action failed. Check the desktop app.
RemoteWeb.connectionFailed: Cannot connect. Check that Web Remote is running, then retry.
RemoteWeb.incompatible: A time range excludes subtitles and SponsorBlock; removal excludes subtitles.
RemoteWeb.sponsorblock-mark-requires-mkv: Select explicit MKV for SponsorBlock Mark. MP4 chapters are broken and WebM is unverified.
RemoteWeb.sponsorblock-remove-experiment: Added to queue. Remove is experimental: stream-copy cuts can have timing inaccuracies.
RemoteWeb.cookie-file-missing: The selected cookies file is missing. Choose it again in Settings.
RemoteWeb.cookie-file-unreadable: The cookies file cannot be read. Check access in Settings.
RemoteWeb.cookie-file-unsupported: The file is not a supported Netscape cookies.txt file.
RemoteWeb.cookie-file-rejected: yt-dlp rejected the cookies file. Export it again.
RemoteWeb.cookie-database-locked: Close the source browser or export cookies to a file in desktop Settings.
RemoteWeb.cookie-profile-unavailable: The configured browser profile is unavailable. Check desktop Settings.
RemoteWeb.cookie-unavailable: Cookies are unavailable. Check desktop Settings.
RemoteWeb.auth: Session expired. Pair again using a new desktop code.
RemoteWeb.liveDesktop: Start a LIVE recording in the desktop app.
RemoteWeb.remoteSourceScope: Remote adding is currently limited to supported YouTube URLs.
RemoteWeb.rangeInvalid: Enter digits: hours up to 720, minutes and seconds from 0 to 59 (30 days maximum).
RemoteWeb.rangeRequired: Set the start or end of the range.
RemoteWeb.rangeOrder: The end must be later than the start.
RemoteWeb.subtitle: Local network remote
RemoteWeb.loginDescription: Enter the short, one-time code shown in Web Remote settings on the computer. Codes expire after 10 minutes.
RemoteWeb.rangeHint: Enter digits only. Leave From empty to start at the beginning, or To empty to continue to the end.
RemoteWeb.footerHttp: Use only on a trusted local network. HTTP traffic is not encrypted.
RemoteWeb.footerHttps: HTTPS encrypts the connection. Verify the certificate fingerprint using the desktop app.
RemoteWeb.authDisabled: Authentication is disabled. Anyone on this network who can reach this address can control the app.
RemoteWeb.pairing-expired: Code expired or already used. Generate a new code in the desktop app.
RemoteWeb.pairing-rate-limit: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and request a new desktop code.
RemoteWeb.pairing-disabled: Pairing is disabled. Reload the page.
RemoteWeb.pairing-unavailable: Pairing is unavailable. Check the desktop app.
History.UnavailableBody: The original history file has been preserved. Check access or restore a valid backup, then restart. History writes and file organization are blocked until it can be read safely.
Updates.StartupAbortBlocked: The updater could not be stopped safely. Download startup and normal application exit are blocked. Resolve the pending updater process and inspect the log before continuing.
